name: Company
description: A site for a small business or consultancy: a home page with what you do, reviews and questions, plus Services with prices, About and Contact.
author: Sitebuilder

screenshots.label: The home page on a computer
The home page on a phone

options.label: The header
options.description: What the bar with the site's name and menu does as a page scrolls.

choices.label: Stays at the top of the window
Hides while scrolling down, and comes back on the way up

options.label: Where the menu sits
options.description: In the header, on screens wide enough to show it. On a phone it's behind the menu button.

options.label: Show the menu's last link as a button
options.description: For the one place you most want visitors to go, such as Contact. It stays in the header on a phone too.

options.label: Fonts
options.description: A pair for headings and text, from the fonts visitors' devices already have. A pair takes the place of the fonts set in Appearance.

choices.label: The theme's, as set in Appearance
Classic: serif headings over plain text
Editorial: serifs throughout, as a magazine
Friendly: rounded headings over warm text
Technical: typewriter headings over geometric text
